scenarios.theme: Doubling pods causes connection failures. Should each pod raise its pool limit?
scenarios.assumptions: A fleet grows from 20 to 40 replicas, each allowed ten physical database sessions. The database admits far fewer than 400 application sessions after operational reserves. What will you do?
